note: The public list of Atoll Pro items. The sources live only in the private Pro repository (docs/pro/README.md); this file and the screenshots are what the docs site and the pricing page may show.

items.name: header_01
items.title: Header
items.description: Sticky marketing header: page links, light/dark switch, sign in, a call to action, and a menu sheet on phones.

items.name: hero_01
items.title: Hero, centred
items.description: Announcement pill, a headline whose words rise in one by one, a pitch, two actions and reassurances. Holds the page's h1.

items.name: hero_02
items.title: Hero, split
items.description: Headline and email sign-up beside a product preview that floats in while its numbers count up.

items.name: logo_cloud_01
items.title: Logo cloud
items.description: Customer wordmarks as a wrapped grid or a pausable marquee.

items.name: features_01
items.title: Feature grid
items.description: Six icon cards that stagger in as the grid scrolls into view.

items.name: features_02
items.title: Feature rows
items.description: Alternating text and picture rows; each picture slides in from its own side.

items.name: stats_01
items.title: Stats
items.description: A band of key figures that count up with a spring the first time they are seen.

items.name: pricing_01
items.title: Pricing tiers
items.description: Three plans with a monthly/yearly switch: the highlight glides between options and prices spring to their new value.

items.name: pricing_02
items.title: Plan comparison
items.description: A full comparison table with grouped features, named check and dash marks, and per-plan actions.

items.name: testimonials_01
items.title: Testimonials
items.description: A featured quote over a masonry grid of quotes with names, roles, avatars and ratings.

items.name: faq_01
items.title: FAQ
items.description: Questions in an accordion beside a heading and a contact link.

items.name: cta_01
items.title: Call to action
items.description: A bold panel in the accent colour with two actions and a drifting light.

items.name: footer_01
items.title: Footer
items.description: Newsletter sign-up, four link columns, copyright and social links.

items.name: reveal
items.title: Reveal
items.description: Plays a spring entrance the first time content scrolls into view; stagger with a delay. Content stays readable without JavaScript and under reduced motion.

items.name: number_ticker
items.title: Number ticker
items.description: Counts up to a value with a spring, and springs to each new value; screen readers hear the final value once.

items.name: saas_starter
items.title: SaaS starter
items.description: A whole product: landing and pricing pages, sign in and sign up with an email code, and a signed-in app with overview, projects, team, billing and settings. Web and desktop.
